note: Checks expected to fail until the named 4.3 plan item lands. verify-release.mjs reports such a suite as XFAIL, and as XPASS (a failure) once every listed check passes, so each entry is removed by the change that fixes it. label is a regular expression over check labels; browser and modes (candidate, release, staged-release, prebuilt) narrow an entry.

entries.label: ^candidate: .* (composed block words|link names|heading names) equal source$
entries.reason: test:release runs the committed packages/typeset-v4/dist, which is the published 4.2.0 build with the joined-word defect until 4.3.0 is cut.
